## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and the narrow implementation boundary.

## Verification

- [ ] I added or updated a test and observed it fail before the implementation change.
- [ ] Focused tests pass.
- [ ] Full quality checks appropriate to this change pass.
- [ ] OpenAPI and generated TypeScript types are synchronized when the API changed.
- [ ] User and developer documentation are synchronized when behavior changed.

## Privacy and security

- [ ] No credentials, cookies, private PDFs, full prompts, backups, local application state, or personal reading data are committed.
- [ ] Fixtures are synthetic or redistributable and contain no identifying information.
- [ ] New networking, filesystem, Agent, and plugin permissions are documented and tested.

## Release impact

State whether this changes stored data, API compatibility, plugin compatibility, packaging, or the supported Windows environment.
